subject: Crystal Desert
text: From getting Nuke, navigate south, east, north, east, north, east, south to the ocean dock, then south, south, east across the ocean to reach the Crystal Desert dock.

evidence.quote:
Go S, E, N, E, N, E, S
- Use dock to enter ocean
Go S, S, E
- Use dock to get onto the Crystal Desert

subject: Ruins entrance
text: The entrance to the Ruins is revealed by casting Nuke on the right crystal.

evidence.quote: Reveal the entrance by casting Nuke on the right crystal.

subject: Mirrors
text: Mirrors fire projectiles while Snails do not, and both enemies die from a single Nuke cast.

evidence.quote:
Mirrors have projectiles.  Snails do not.
--- Both die in a single Nuke cast.

subject: Robots
text: Robots in the Ruins can be defeated with Lit magic, whereas Nuke does not affect them.

evidence.quote: If you must kill one, Lit works, while Nuke does not.

subject: Experience
text: Snails, Mirrors, Earth Elementals, and Moths each yield 100-150 Experience.

evidence.quote:
Each of those enemies is 100-150 Experience, and you can see how close to
    a level you are on the Status screen or by saving.

subject: Center tiles
text: To proceed north, step on the left half of the center tiles until pushed to the right side, then step on the upper right tile.

evidence.quote:
To go north here, use the left half of the center tiles until you get kicked
  to the right side, then use the upper right tile.

subject: Center tiles
text: To proceed east, step on the left half of the center tiles until kicked to the upper side, then use the upper right tile.

evidence.quote:
To go east here, use the left half of the center tiles until you get kicked
  to the upper side, the use the upper right tile.

subject: Mantis Ant
text: Against Mantis Ant, stay still and cast Fire whenever the Will meter fills.

evidence.quote:
BOSS: Mantis Ant
- Don't move.
- Cast Fire when your Will meter fills.

subject: Damage tiles
text: Equip Cure after defeating Mantis Ant to survive the 100HP damage tiles while crossing the arena to the right exit.

evidence.quote:
After he's dead, equip Cure, and survive the 100HP damage tiles as you enter
  the arena then exit to the right.

subject: Rusty Sword
text: Equipping the Rusty Sword and pressing the button releases its mystic power.

evidence.quote:
Equip the Rusty Sword
- Press the button.
"The Rusty Sword released it is mystic power..."

subject: Ruins
text: From the Ruins, travel south, south, east, south, and west through the desert to enter Dime Tower.

evidence.quote:
- Get Chocobo.
- Goal: arrive at Dime Tower.
Go S, S, E, S, W
Door (Enters Dime Tower)

subject: Marcie
text: Marcie joins the party inside Dime Tower.

evidence.quote: * Marcie joins.

subject: Marcie
text: Using Marcie's ASK command completely restores your MP.

evidence.quote: Marcie's ASK command gives you full MP.

subject: Birdmen
text: Birdmen in Dime Tower can inflict poison, while the beret-wearing fuzzballs can inflict Moogle status.

evidence.quote: Birdmen can poison, while the Beret wearing fuzzballs can Moogle.

subject: Ice
text: The Ice spell can be steered diagonally, allowing you to freeze Minotaurs without cutting trees that let Marcie destroy them.

evidence.quote:
You can steer the Ice spell to go diagonally.
--- This can help to avoid having to cut trees that enable Marcie to kill your
    snowmen.

subject: Garuda
text: Hiding in the lower left corner evades Garuda's dive when he is on the left side, and hiding in the lower right corner evades him when he is on the right.

evidence.quote:
When Garuda is on the left side, being in the lower left corner will evade
  his dive.
- Likewise, when he is on the right, hide in the lower right.

subject: Garuda
text: Garuda can be defeated using fully charged Nuke blasts.

evidence.quote: Kill Garuda with fully charged Nuke blasts.

subject: Marcie
text: Marcie leaves the party before you automatically ascend the Waterfall.

evidence.quote:
- Marcie leaves
Go W, W, W
- You'll automatically go up the Waterfall.

subject: Ninjas
text: Ninjas fire projectiles dealing around 90 damage, and both Ninjas and Fiend Heads can instantly teleport directly on top of you.

evidence.quote:
Ninjas' projectiles deal around 90 damage.
--- Fiend Heads and Ninjas can both instantaneously teleport anywhere -
    including directly on top of you.

subject: Dragon
text: The Dragon's only vulnerable square is the front foot beneath his head, as shots aimed at his head will be intercepted by his wing.

evidence.quote:
The only vulnerable square is the foot underneath his head.
--- Do NOT target his head!  His wing will intercept shots that high.
--- Again: target his FRONT FOOT.

subject: Dragon
text: Defeat the Dragon using fully charged Nukes, taking advantage of post-hit invincibility from weak fireballs to cast uninterrupted.

evidence.quote:
Use fully charged Nukes.
--- Be careful not to let your cast get interrupted by the (weak) fireballs.
--- Consider intentionally taking a hit from fireballs, then using the
    invincibility time to cast your spell uninterrupted.

subject: Ice
text: In the first Ice room, steer the Ice spell through the labyrinth across the orb to freeze the Minotaur onto the button.

evidence.quote:
This is an Ice room.
- Steer the Ice spell through the labrynth, across the orb and to the Minotaur
  on the button.

subject: Red Dragon
text: Red Dragon has more HP than the previous Dragon, but is otherwise identical in behavior.

evidence.quote:
BOSS: Red Dragon
- This boss has more HP than the last one.  Aside from that, it's identical.

subject: Button
text: In the second Ice room of the Tower of Gemma, the correct floor button is on the left side of the room, second from the bottom.

evidence.quote:
This is an Ice room.
- The correct button is on the left side of the room, second from the bottom.

subject: Dragon Zombie
text: Dragon Zombie aims fireballs directly toward you, and attacking from below with Nuke helps hit his erratically moving heads.

evidence.quote:
BOSS: Dragon Zombie
- This boss is like Hydra, except its fireballs aim toward you rather than
  horizontally.
- Fire is my choice; Nuke could be okay if you have a lot of X-Ethers left.
--- If you use Nuke, attack from below so that you don't miss his erratically
    moving heads.

subject: XCalibr
text: You obtain the XCalibr along the one-way path after teleporting from Dragon Zombie.

evidence.quote:
- The path here is one-way, so I won't bother giving directions.
- You'll get the XCalibr.

subject: Julius 1
text: Julius 1's Nukes deal about 20 damage while touching him deals about 100 damage, and fully charged Nukes kill the clones in 1 hit.

evidence.quote:
His Nukes deal about 20 damage, while touching him deals about 100 damage.
- He can move in a variety of ways, he can slowly fade out and reappear in the
  destination he was walking to, or he can instantly teleport.
--- Instant teleporting is allowed to target your current square, so keep
    yourself above 100 HP.
- Use fully charged Nukes, and you should kill the Julius clones in 1 hit.

subject: Julius 1
text: You must defeat the final Julius 1 clone while standing on the left or bottom side of the screen.

evidence.quote:
You MUST kill the final Julius 1 clone while standing on the left or bottom
  side of the screen!

subject: Julius 2
text: Avoid attacking Julius 2 from below when he is on the left or right sides to prevent being caught by his dangerous diagonal dive.

evidence.quote:
The diagonal dive is dangerous; don't attack Julius 2 from below when he's
  on the right or left side or else you cannot avoid the diagonal dive.

subject: Julius 3
text: Julius 3 fires 2 Nukes from set positions with invincible hands; his Nukes can be intercepted by timed shots from opposite positions.

evidence.quote:
At each position, Julius will raise his hands then fire 2 Nukes toward you.
- His hands are invincible.
- Below are instructions.
--- The format is Enemy Position: Your position, your action.

Top Center: Bottom Center, walk left until shoot up.
Left: Right Center, shoot left (time shot to intercept Julius's Nukes)

subject: HP
text: Your maximum HP equals 19 + (Stamina * Stamina) * 0.1, with any fractional HP truncated.

evidence.quote:
Your max HP = 19 + (Stamina * Stamina) * 0.1
Fractional HP is truncated.

subject: Will bar
text: Each point of Will increases the Will bar by 0.00625 each second.

evidence.quote: Each point of Will grants 0.00625 of the Will bar each second.

subject: Damage calculation
text: Damage taken from enemies is calculated as Enemy's Attack - (Your Stamina + Your Armor + Your Helmet).

evidence.quote:
When enemies attack you, damage works like this:
Damage = Enemy's Attack - (Your Stamina + Your Armor + Your Helmet)

subject: Physical attack
text: Physical damage equals (1 + Will%) * (Power + Weapon Base Power - Enemy's Defense), doubling when the Will bar is full.

evidence.quote:
Damage = (1 + Will%) * (Power + Weapon Base Power - Enemy's Defense)

Will% is what fraction of the Will meter is full.
So, if you have a full Will bar, damage is doubled.

subject: Sword
text: The Sword's spinning special attack and the return trip of the Flying Sword Attack both calculate damage as though Will% = 0.

evidence.quote:
The Sword's spinning special attack acts as though Will% = 0.
--- The Sword's return trip from the Flying Sword Attack acts as though
    Will% = 0.

subject: Magical attack
text: Magical damage equals (1 + Will%) * (2 * Wisdom + Spell's Base Damage - Magic Resistance), and is multiplied by 2 if Will% = 100%.

evidence.quote:
Damage = (1 + Will%) * (2 * Wisdom + Spell's Base Damage - Magic Resistance)
         Damage multiplied by 2 if Will% = 100%

subject: Wisdom
text: Each point of Wisdom provides 2 points of damage on uncharged spells and 8 points of damage on fully charged spells.

evidence.quote:
So, if you fire uncharged spells, each point of Wisdom grants 2 points of
damage, whereas for fully charged spells, each Wisdom point grants 8 points of
damage.

subject: Flame Chain
text: All enemies immune to the Flame Chain are immune to Fire, but some enemies weak against the Flame Chain are not weak against Fire.

evidence.quote:
Although all enemies immune to the Flame Chain are immune to Fire, some
enemies weak against the Flame Chain are not weak against Fire.

subject: Dragon Armor
text: Go W, N(K), E to get the Dragon Armor.

evidence.quote:
Go W, N(K), E
- Get the Dragon Armor
